1856.name: Vanish
1856.description: Allows you to vanish from sight, entering stealth while in combat. For the first 3 sec after vanishing, damage and harmful effects received will not break stealth. Also breaks movement impairing effects.

1966.name: Feint
1966.description: Performs an evasive maneuver, reducing damage taken from area-of-effect attacks by 40% for 6 sec.

5277.name: Evasion
5277.description: Increases your dodge chance by 100% for 10 sec.

5938.name: Shiv
5938.description: Attack with your off-hand, dealing 2 Physical damage, dispelling all enrage effects and applying a concentrated form of your active Non-Lethal poison. Awards 1 combo point.

13750.name: Adrenaline Rush
13750.description: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 75%, your maximum Energy by 50, and your attack speed by 20% for 15 sec.

31224.name: Cloak of Shadows
31224.description: Provides a moment of magic immunity, instantly removing all harmful spell effects. The cloak lingers, causing you to resist harmful spells for 5 sec.

42650.name: Army of the Dead
42650.description: Summon or empower Lesser Ghouls to form an unholy army of 8 for 30 sec. While active, summoning a Lesser Ghoul will instead execute Orders based on nearby enemies. Death Orders Lesser Ghouls strike with you, dealing 11 Shadow damage to your target. Epidemic Orders Lesser Ghouls erupt in viscera, dealing 2 Shadow damage to nearby enemies. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

46585.name: Raise Dead
46585.description: Raises a ghoul to fight by your side. You can have a maximum of one ghoul at a time. Lasts 1 min.

48265.name: Death's Advance
48265.description: For 10 sec, your movement speed is increased by 35%, you cannot be slowed below 100% of normal speed, and you are immune to forced movement effects and knockbacks. Passive: You cannot be slowed below 70% of normal speed.

48707.name: Anti-Magic Shell
48707.description: Surrounds you in an Anti-Magic Shell for 5 sec, absorbing up to 9,165 magic damage and preventing application of harmful magical effects. Damage absorbed generates Runic Power.

48792.name: Icebound Fortitude
48792.description: Your blood freezes, granting immunity to Stun effects and reducing all damage you take by 30% for 8 sec.

49039.name: Lichborne
49039.description: Draw upon unholy energy to become Undead for 10 sec, increasing Leech by 6% and making you immune to Charm, Fear, and Sleep.

51052.name: Anti-Magic Zone
51052.description: Places an Anti-Magic Zone for 6 sec, reducing the magic damage taken by party or raid members by 15%.

51271.name: Pillar of Frost
51271.description: The power of frost increases your Strength by 20% for 12 sec.

51690.name: Killing Spree
51690.description: Finishing move that unleashes a barrage of gunfire, striking random enemies within 8 yards for Physical damage. Number of strikes increased per combo point. Restores 1 combo point every 0.45 sec. Each combo point spent above 5 increases damage by 15%. 1 point : 314 over 0.45 sec 2 points: 471 over 0.89 sec 3 points: 627 over 1.34 sec 4 points: 784 over 1.78 sec 5 points: 941 over 2.23 sec

108271.name: Astral Shift
108271.description: Shift partially into the elemental planes, taking 40% less damage for 12 sec.

114050.name: Ascendance
114050.description: Transform into a Flame Ascendant for 15 sec, instantly casting a Flame Shock and a 50% effectiveness Lava Burst at up to 6 nearby enemies. While ascended, Elemental Overload damage is increased by 30% and spells affected by your Mastery: Elemental Overload cause 1 additional Elemental Overload.

114051.name: Ascendance
114051.description: Transform into an Air Ascendant for 15 sec and unleash Doom Winds, reducing the cooldown and cost of Stormstrike by 60%, and transforming your auto attack and Stormstrike into Wind attacks which bypass armor and have a 30 yd range. Maelstrom Weapon spenders have a 0.5% chance to unleash Doom Winds per Maelstrom Weapon spent while Ascendance is not active.

121471.name: Shadow Blades
121471.description: Draws upon surrounding shadows to empower your weapons, causing your attacks to deal 20% additional damage as Shadow and causing your combo point generating abilities to generate double combo points for 16 sec.

185311.name: Crimson Vial
185311.description: Drink an alchemical concoction that heals you for 20% of your maximum health over 4 sec.

185313.name: Shadow Dance
185313.description: Allows the use of Stealth abilities, grants the combat benefits of Stealth, and drastically reduces threat for 6 sec. Effect not broken from taking damage or attacking.

191634.name: Stormkeeper
191634.description: Charge yourself with lightning, causing your next 2 Lightning Bolts to be instant cast and deal 150% more damage, or cause your next 2 Chain Lightings to be instant cast and trigger an Elemental Overload on every target.

192077.name: Wind Rush Totem
192077.description: Summons a totem at the target location for 15 sec, continually granting all allies who pass within 10 yards 40% increased movement speed for 5 sec.

198103.name: Earth Elemental
198103.description: Calls forth a Greater Earth Elemental to protect you and your allies, generating high threat and taunting enemies periodically for 30 sec.

280719.name: Secret Technique
280719.description: Finishing move that creates shadow clones of yourself. You and your shadow clones each perform a piercing attack on all enemies near your target, dealing Physical damage to the primary target and reduced damage to other targets. 1 point : 29 total damage 2 points: 59 total damage 3 points: 89 total damage 4 points: 118 total damage 5 points: 150 total damage

360194.name: Deathmark
360194.description: Carve a deathmark into an enemy, dealing 125 Bleed damage and restoring 80 Energy to you over 16 sec. Damage dealt to the target by your Garrote, Rupture, and Lethal Poisons is increased by 75%. Each time you apply a Lethal Poison to the target, apply it twice.

381989.name: Keep It Rolling
381989.description: Increase the remaining duration of your active Roll the Bones combat enhancement by 30 sec.

385627.name: Kingsbane
385627.description: Release a powerful poison from your weapons and inject it into your target, dealing 51 Nature damage instantly and an additional 71 Nature damage over 14 sec. Each time you apply a Lethal Poison to a target affected by Kingsbane, Kingsbane damage increases by 20%, up to 1,000%. Awards 1 combo point.

426591.name: Goremaw's Bite
426591.description: Lash out at your target and 2 additional nearby enemies, inflicting 216 Shadow damage and causing them to Bleed for 428 damage over 14 sec. 20% of all damage from Finishing Moves is repeated as Shadow, split evenly among affected enemies.

439843.name: Reaper's Mark
439843.description: Viciously slice into the soul of your enemy, dealing 81 Shadowfrost damage and applying Reaper's Mark. Each time you deal Shadow or Frost damage, add a stack of Reaper's Mark. After 12 sec or reaching 40 stacks, the mark explodes, dealing 10 damage per stack. Reaper's Mark travels to an unmarked enemy nearby if the target dies.

1233448.name: Dark Transformation
1233448.description: Corrupt and evolve your Ghoul into a Monstrosity, greatly empowering its abilities for 15 sec. Death Coil and Epidemic extends the duration of this effect by 1.0 sec.

1249658.name: Breath of Sindragosa
1249658.description: Call upon Sindragosa's aid in battle for 8 sec, continuously dealing 39 Frost damage every 1 sec to enemies in a cone in front of you. Consuming Killing Machine or Rime increases the duration by 0.8 sec. Deals reduced damage to secondary targets. Grants a charge of Empower Rune Weapon at the start and 2 Runes at the end.

-193701.name: Algeth'ar Puzzle Box
-193701.description: Use: Solve a puzzle, increasing your Mastery by 112 for 20 sec. (2 Min Cooldown)

-249344.name: Light Company Guidon
-249344.description: Equip: You are a volunteer of the Vanguard of the Light. Use: Lead the charge to gain 74 Haste for 15 sec. All Vanguard of the Light volunteers within 40 yards also gain 18 Speed for 6 sec. (1 Min 30 Sec Cooldown)

-249345.name: Ranger-Captain's Iridescent Insignia
-249345.description: Use: Unleash a Silverstrike Trick Shot, critically striking your target and a nearby enemy for 1,207 Arcane damage. This damage is further increased by your critical strike chance. Your critical strikes have a high chance to reduce this cooldown by 5 sec. (3 Min Cooldown)

-249346.name: Vaelgor's Final Stare
-249346.description: Use: Seize the eye's draconic power, granting you 133 Mastery diminishing over 15 sec and allowing you to see hidden enemies. (1 Min 30 Sec Cooldown)

-250144.name: Emberwing Feather
-250144.description: Use: Unleash an Emberwing Heatwave, increasing your Haste by 68 for 15 sec. You have a low chance to suffer an Emberwing Burn, reducing one of your other secondary stats by 21 for 10 sec. (2 Min Cooldown)

-250215.name: Freightrunner's Flask
-250215.description: Use: Take a sip of the drink you swiped from the freight, increasing your Critical Strike by 48 for 15 sec. (1 Min 30 Sec Cooldown)

-250225.name: Void Execution Mandate
-250225.description: Use: Mark your target for execution, increasing your Haste by 24 for 20 sec. While the target is marked, each of your attacks against them grants an additional 1 Critical Strike, as the Void urges you to finish the kill, up to a maximum of 26 Critical Strike. (2 Min Cooldown)

-250238.name: Seed of the Devouring Wild
-250238.description: Use: Awaken the Bloodthorn Roots, erupting around your target and inflicting 492 Nature damage split among nearby enemies. You absorb their essence, gaining 28 Mastery for 10 sec. (1 Min 30 Sec Cooldown)

-270160.name: First Mate's Shellward
-270160.description: Use: Deploy the Shellward to absorb up to 40% of incoming damage until 121,947 damage has been prevented for up to 30 sec. The Shellward hardens while you are below 40% health, reducing damage by 80% instead. Deal 6,067 Physical damage to melee attackers while the Shellward holds. (1 Min 30 Sec Cooldown)

-270168.name: Font of Venomous Rage
-270168.description: Use: Channel a torrent of venomous rage over 2 sec, dealing 306,137 Nature damage to your target and splattering all nearby enemies for 53,875 Nature damage. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets. (4 Min Cooldown)

-270169.name: Hex Lord's Dooming Idol
-270169.description: Equip: Your spells afflict you with Hex Lord's Doom, draining your Intellect by 1 up to 30 times. This effect may occur once every 6 sec. Use: Consume the power of Hex Lord's Doom, increasing your Intellect by 12 per stack for 30 sec. (30 Sec Cooldown)

-270175.name: Voracious Heart of Ula'tek
-270175.description: Use: Bite the heart and embrace the ravening hunger, gaining 149 Strength or Agility for 20 sec. While the hunger persists, gain a very high chance to devour a morsel of your target with every attack, dealing 3,525 Physical damage and further increasing your Strength or Agility by 16. (1 Min 30 Sec Cooldown)

-273796.name: Vile Vial of Volatile Venom
-273796.description: Use: Take a small sip of venom, gaining 513 of a random secondary stat for 15 sec. Afterwards, a random secondary stat is reduced by 73 for 15 sec. (2 Min Cooldown)

-273797.name: Tattered Amani War Banner
-273797.description: Use: Plant the banner for 15 sec! Fighting within 12 yards of it fills you with Battle Fervor, granting 305 of your highest secondary stat. Defeating at least 1 enemy while the banner stands will extend Banner's duration by 5 sec. (1 Min 30 Sec Cooldown)

-280376.name: Shadow Shard Sliver
-280376.description: Use: Raise the crystal, granting you 760 Haste for 12 sec. (2 Min Cooldown)
